Five injured after bridge structural failure

Emergency crews responded to the bridge shortly after 7 a.m.

Officials said five people were injured.

"We are still assessing the situation," the fire chief said.

Investigation underway

Engineers were examining the structure to determine what caused the failure.

The bridge will remain closed while inspectors assess the damage.

Update: Officials confirmed that five people were injured.
Correction: An earlier version of this article misstated the time of the incident.
